_comment: Widgets still allowed to define their own `refresh_theme()` in metatv/gui/**.
SHRINK-ONLY: an entry may be removed, never added. A new one means somebody
rebuilt the hand-maintained sweep THEME-1 deleted — 22 overrides behind ~838
setStyleSheet call sites, an enumeration that could never see what nobody
remembered to add. Style a widget with theme.style()/theme.style_fn() at
construction instead: apply_theme() re-applies every live registration.
For work a stylesheet cannot express (a cached QColor, a repainted custom
delegate, a recoloured pixmap), use theme.register_post_apply(fn) with a
weakly-bound callable — that is a registration too, not a sweep. Icon
buttons already have one: icon_utils.set_button_icon() registers them and
refresh_icon_buttons() is that hook, so pass a colour BUILDER for a
palette token and the glyph follows a switch with no method here.
It is EMPTY on purpose: the migration left no survivor.
